svg.aria-label: AgentRQ search and keyboard shortcuts: claude has a question on a task you cannot see in a busy workspace, so you press ⌘K and type 'migration'. The finder narrows the tasks saved on this device to 'Run the users migration' without asking the server; Enter opens it and C flips to the chat, where you answer and claude finishes. Then W, P and ? bring up the workspace switcher, the Pano and the keyboard shortcuts sheet while the agents celebrate.
